events.title: Kebni Q3 report 2026
events.text: Net sales for the third quarter amounted to 28,7 MSEK (30,4 MSEK). Cash flow was strengthened by the proceeds from the directed share issue, providing greater financial flexibility to pursue strategic initiatives. Financial development Jul-Sep 2026 (KSEK) · Net sales, 28 720 (30 422), -6% year-on-year · EBITDA, 1 400 (3 479), 5% (11%) · Net profit for the period, 3 374 (938), 12% (3%) · Adjusted net profit for the period, -626 (-2%) · Operating cash flow for the period, - 6 069 (-10 543) · Net cash flow for the period, 47 379 (-9 562) · Earnings per share before dilution, 0,01 (0,00) * Adjusted net profit for the period excludes the gain of 4 000 KSEK from the sale of the holding in ScaffSense in Q3. Financial development Jan-Sep 2026 (KSEK) · Net sales 70 601 (99 061), -29% year-on-year · EBITDA, -5 372 (11 781), -8% (12%) · Net profit for the period, -20 490 (4 203), -29% (4%) · Adjusted net profit for the period, -13 382 (-19%) * · Operating cash flow for the period, - 20 863 (-2 682) · Net cash flow for the period, 23 486 (-7 885) · Earnings per share before dilution, -0,06 (0,02) * Adjusted net profit for the period excludes the net negative effect of 7 108 KSEK related to ScaffSense, comprising an impairment of 11 108 KSEK recognized in Q2 and a gain of 4 000 KSEK from the sale of the holding in Q3. Significant events Jul-Sep 2026 · The company provided an update regarding the financial outcome for the first six months of 2026. · Kebni received an aftermarket order for spare parts to support the servicing of maritime satellite terminals operated by a European NATO country. · The company received an additional volume order for continued production and deliveries of the tailored IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) for Saab’s NLAW antitank system. · Kebni AB completed a directed share issue of SEK 55 million. · Kebni divested its shares in ScaffSense. Comments from the CEO The third quarter was marked by continued progress in customer projects. Net sales for the third quarter amounted to 28,7 MSEK, compared to 30,4 MSEK in the corresponding period last year. Several customer opportunities within Satcom have reached advanced stages, with Kebni well positioned in the respective customer projects. As our customers work towards finalizing contracts with their end customers, the timing of our orders remains dependent on the progress of these processes. None of these potential orders are lost. Inertial Sensing – Operational recovery and customer opportunities Within Inertial Sensing, we achieved a full recovery from the component shortages experienced earlier this year, in line with our previously communicated expectations. Production is now back at the volumes required to meet current customer demand. Customer confidence was further demonstrated by an additional 22 MSEK volume order from Saab for tailored IMUs for the NLAW anti-tank system. Deliveries from this specific order will continue through 2027. The continued orders demonstrate the strength of our long-standing customer relationship and our ability to progress from development into sustained series production. We are involved in a growing number of customer evaluation and integration projects. As these projects progress, our technology becomes increasingly embedded in customers’ development programs, strengthening our position as a long-term supplier and creating opportunities for future volume orders. Kebni has, as previously communicated, decided to invest in production capacity with the objective of doubling our current maximum capacity. We are also continuing to develop our IMU portfolio to meet expected customer requirements. Security of supply remains a key priority to our customers, and we continue to strengthen the European share of our supply chain to ensure reliable deliveries and reduce dependencies on non-European suppliers.
